description: Convert video and audio files between formats. Includes presets for web MP4 (H.264/AAC), WebM (VP9/Opus), and animated GIF. Supports hardware acceleration on Apple Silicon, NVIDIA, Intel, and AMD.

crf.description: Quality factor from 0 to 51. Lower numbers mean higher quality. Default: 23 for MP4, 30 for WebM.

fps.description: Target frame rate in frames per second, such as 30, 60, or 15

hardwareAcceleration.description: Use hardware-accelerated video encoding (VideoToolbox, NVENC, QSV, etc.) when available. Default: true.

inputPath.description: Path to the source media file to convert

outputPath.description: Destination path for the converted file (e.g. ./output.mp4, ./output.webm, ./animation.gif)

preset.description: Encoding preset: 'web_mp4' for browser playback, 'webm' for WebM video, 'gif' for animated GIF, or 'auto'. Default: 'auto'.

resolution.description: Target size formatted as 'WIDTHxHEIGHT', such as '1920x1080' or '1280x720'

name: media_convert
